# Outputs Directory

This directory is the centralized location for all generated assets, charts, and benchmark results produced by the evaluation scripts.

## Expected Outputs
*   `phase1_throughput.png`: The SSD throughput graph generated by `utils/plot_phase1.py`.
*   `solidattention_tradeoff_{model_name}.png` (or `dummy_solidattention_tradeoff_{model_name}.png` for dummy runs): The final dual-axis simulation chart generated by `scripts/phase3_simulation.py`.
